diffs.diff: minimum supply: part 2.7 V, datasheet reading 3 V
diffs.evidence: The only active chip on COM-15168 is the ATtiny85 (schematic/Eagle files list ATTINY85, SparkFun IC-09092). Microchip ATtiny25/45/85 datasheet, Features: 'Operating Voltage - 1.8 - 5.5V for ATtiny25V/45V/85V - 2.7 - 5.5V for ATtiny25/45/85', and the firmware's 8 MHz clock is within '0 - 10 MHz @ 2.7 - 5.5V'. SparkFun's hookup guide gives no 3 V minimum: it says 'The Qwiic system is meant to run on 3.3V' and 'the operating voltage of the ATtiny85 ranges from 1.8 to 5.5V, and the EEPROM needs at least 2V'. So 2.7 V (the non-V ATtiny85 minimum) is the correct, conservative documented minimum; the 3 V figure has no source and appears to be a rounded reading of the 3.3 V Qwiic nominal.
